Guinea-Bissau|ca: Canada has no regulation aimed at Guinea-Bissau; its Current sanctions page lists none. The UN resolution 2048 travel ban reaches Canada only through the general inadmissibility rule in the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, section 35.1, which is not a country measure. https://www.international.gc.ca/world-monde/international_relations-relations_internationales/sanctions/current-actuelles.aspx?lang=eng ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/I-2.5/page-6.html (checked 12 Nov 2026)
